entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:2
segments: ¶Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love [is] better than wine. {thy...: Heb. thy loves}

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:3
segments: Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name [is as] ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:4
segments: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee. {the upright...: or, they love thee uprightly}

words.text: thee. {the upright...: or, they love thee uprightly}

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:5
segments: I [am] black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:6
segments: Look not upon me, because I [am] black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother's children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; [but] mine own vineyard have I not kept.

words.text: not upon me, because I [am] black

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:7
segments: ¶Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest, where thou makest [thy flock] to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions? {as one...: or, as one that is veiled}

words.text: me, O thou whom my soul
why should I be as one that turneth aside
? {as one...: or, as one that is veiled}

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:8
segments: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds' tents.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:9
segments: I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh's chariots.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:10
segments: Thy cheeks are comely with rows [of jewels], thy neck with chains [of gold].

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:11
segments: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:12
segments: ¶While the king [sitteth] at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:13
segments: A bundle of myrrh [is] my wellbeloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:14
segments: My beloved [is] unto me [as] a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of Engedi. {camphire: or, cypress}

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:15
segments: Behold, thou [art] fair, my love; behold, thou [art] fair; thou [hast] doves' eyes. {my love: or, my companion}

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:16
segments: Behold, thou [art] fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed [is] green.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:17
segments: The beams of our house [are] cedar, [and] our rafters of fir. {rafters: or, galleries}
